name.fr-FR: Élévation à Jésus-Christ sur la conduite de sa grâce vers sainte Madeleine
name.en-US: Elevation to Jesus Christ on the Conduct of His Grace toward St. Mary Magdalene
name.pt-BR: Elevação a Jesus Cristo sobre a conduta de sua graça para com santa Madalena

description.fr-FR: Vingt chapitres (1627), dédiés à la reine Henriette d’Angleterre, sur la conversion, l’amour et la pénitence de sainte Madeleine, suivis des Observations sur le texte de saint Luc.
description.en-US: Twenty chapters (1627), dedicated to Queen Henrietta Maria of England, on the conversion, love and penance of St. Mary Magdalene, followed by the Observations on St. Luke’s text.
description.pt-BR: Vinte capítulos (1627), dedicados à rainha Henriqueta Maria da Inglaterra, sobre a conversão, o amor e a penitência de santa Madalena, seguidos das Observações sobre o texto de são Lucas.

sources.edition: Œuvres complètes du cardinal de Bérulle, éd. Migne, Paris, 1856 (reprint of Bourgoing’s 1644 collected edition); archive.org OCR (ABBYY) of the Toronto copy.
sources.description: Machine-cleaned OCR: running heads, page numbers and hyphenation removed, paragraphs rejoined, obvious character errors corrected by a vote against the corpus vocabulary. Residual OCR errors, merged columns and some chapter openings the scan lost remain (see PROBLEMS.md).
sources.tierEvidence: Bérulle died in 1629; the 1856 edition is public domain.
